rule: Only W0 grants, extends, or revokes a lease. A producer must never write a hot file without holding an active lease. Requesting a lease requires a CHANGE_REQUEST naming the symbol, the reason, the intended patch, and the test that proves it.

activeLeases.scope: Deterministic managed/custom model routing, same-route retry and secret-free route decisions
conditions: Custom disabled routes explicitly to managed; custom enabled with invalid config or missing key fails closed and never silently falls back to managed.
Provider, endpoint and model are frozen for each request; runtime failure cannot trigger cross-provider or cross-model fallback.
Only the narrow recognised streaming incompatibility may retry once, non-streamed, on the same route/model/idempotency key.
Route decisions and diagnostics contain no raw secret, URL credential, query or fragment.
Loop 05 host/context bytes remain unchanged and no second context path is introduced.
No real network, account, billing, package, DB/schema, IPC, renderer or deployment side effect.

activeLeases.scope: Secret-free integration-grant contracts, deterministic legacy mapping and injected no-value grant-vault facade
readOnlyPaths: apps/desktop/src/shared/personal-office/** except the three exact leased files
conditions: IntegrationGrant is amended additively with lastErrorAt and invalid only; PERSONAL_OFFICE_SCHEMA_VERSION is unchanged.
No raw credential value appears in contracts, fixtures, logs, errors, events, hashes or handoffs.
Every grant is bound to exact workspace, integration and least-privilege scopes; wildcards and cross-workspace reuse fail closed.
Vault access exposes resolvability only and never returns the raw value.
Legacy error text is not preserved; only redacted reason codes and timestamps are allowed.
Revocation is plan/result modeling only; no vault deletion, remote disconnect, account mutation, persistence or network side effect.
